name: How do I know if a contractor has enough experience for my type of project?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if a contractor has enough experience for my type of project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for completed projects that match your building type, budget range, and level of complexity. Experience matters most when the contractor can explain how they handled permits, scheduling, occupied-site work, and coordination on similar jobs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for similar completed projects, not just general construction experience. Ask how they handled permits, occupied spaces, and trade coordination.
